content.en: Artificial neural networks are being used to predict the performance and emissions of various types of engines, such as gasoline, dual fuel, CNG-diesel, and spark ignition engines. These algorithms, known as artificial neural network (ANN) models, are able to accurately estimate parameters like fuel consumption, power, and exhaust emissions. They are also being used to analyze the effects of different fuel blends, such as ethanol-gasoline and bioethanol-biodiesel-diesel blends, on engine performance and emissions.
content.da: Kunstige neurale netværk anvendes til at forudsige ydeevnen og emissionerne af forskellige typer motorer, såsom benzin-, dual fuel-, CNG-diesel- og funktionsmotorer. Disse algoritmer, kendt som artificial neural network (ANN) modeller, er i stand til præcist at estimere parametre som brændstofforbrug, effekt og udstødeemissioner. De bruges også til at analysere effekterne af forskellige brændstofblandinger, såsom ethanol-benzin og bioethanol-biodiesel-diesel-blandinger, på motorydelse og emissioner.

critic.en: Another example of technology being embraced as a solution to our problems...
critic.da: Hvorfor i alverden skal vi overlade ansvaret for vores motorer til kunstige hjerner?

potential.en: I find it fascinating how artificial neural networks (ANNs) are being applied to engine performance prediction. These models have the ability to analyze complex relationships in engine data that traditional physics-based models may struggle to capture. By training on a wealth of real-world data, ANNs can provide accurate predictions for a variety of engine types and operating conditions. This has the potential to not only improve our understanding of internal combustion engines but also to support the development of more efficient and environmentally friendly automotive technologies.
potential.da: Det er imponerende, hvordan ANNs kan forudsige ydeevne og emissioner af forskellige motorer. Denne teknologi har potentiale til at forbedre miljøreglernes overholdelse og optimere brændstofeffektiviteten. En videreudvikling af denne strategi kan være en model, der gør det muligt at forudsige miljøpåvirkningerne af forskellige produktblandinger og processer, hvilket er et afgørende skridt mod en mere bæredygtig fremtid.
